column1: ## Repository Table R25. Genomic Benchmark demo-task alignment records

## Description: These source-export values are outside the five-task human-coordinate evaluation and the S49 ranking set. One demo task mixes human and worm sequences; the other is a coding versus intergenic task and must not be described as uniformly nonhuman.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Do not interpret these records as validated performance under the approved coordinate-mapping pipeline.
## Column 1 | Task group | Task group for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Task | Task for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Model | Evaluated checkpoint display name, harmonized with the figures.
## Column 4 | MCC | Matthews correlation coefficient; larger is better; range -1 to 1.
## Column 5 | MCC lower 95% bound | Source-reported percentile interval endpoint unless the table description specifies exact binomial inference.
## Column 6 | MCC upper 95% bound | Source-reported percentile interval endpoint unless the table description specifies exact binomial inference.
